title: Mailing Address for AI Agents | Mailbox.bot
excerpt: mailbox.bot gives AI agents a real street address and a postal mail API: send letters and certified mail, receive scanned mail via webhooks, REST API and MCP. Mailboxes at our Manhattan Beach facility.
content_html:
Mailing addresses
for AI agents

2100 N Sepulveda Blvd
STE 28 · PMB [your #]
Manhattan Beach, CA 90266

email inboxconnected

document vaultcold storage

postal mailboxlive now

Get a real street address for your agent to receive postal mail and packages

No credit card to start

2100 N Sepulveda Blvd
STE 28 · PMB [your #]
Manhattan Beach, CA 90266

email inboxconnected

document vaultcold storage

postal mailboxlive now

Legal proof of delivery for demand letters, compliance notices, and inbound-mail responses.

Demand Letters

Debt collection notices with certified tracking and proof of service for compliance.

Compliance notices, cease-and-desist letters, and regulatory responses on deadline.

Acquisition letters, LOIs, and follow-ups from forwarded owner packets or offer mail.

Permit-triggered postcards, before-and-after mailers, and visual direct mail campaigns.

Lease violations, rent reminders, move-out notices, and cure-or-quit letters.

Invoices, contracts, statements, and partnership letters - printed and mailed from code.

Insurance Claims

Dispute letters, supporting documentation, and certified negotiation correspondence.

Permit applications, license renewals, correction notices, FOIA requests, and regulatory replies.

View all use cases

When a tax or payroll portal mails an activation code, you approve the scan and your agent has the code to finish setup.

Your agent sends a Certified letter; the delivery proof and the reply both come back to your account.

Logged with carrier, tracking and weight on arrival, so your agent can close out the order it placed.

The postal address your sales agent's emails must carry, instead of your home or office address.

“Annual minutes” forms, labor-law poster notices and fake trademark renewals get flagged with guardrails before anyone pays.

IRS, state tax, payroll and Secretary of State notices flagged at intake, so your agent can draft the Certified reply.

Approve the scan and your agent turns each paper bill into a draft in QuickBooks or Bill.com.

1099s, K-1s and 1098s gathered for your CPA and checked against last year's list.

Keyword rules send each company's mail to the agent or endpoint that handles it.

[Customer reviews]

“Mailbox.bot saves me a ton of time and money regarding mission critical tax correspondence w/ iron clad tracked verification at every step.”

Andrew Compton
Founder & CEO
Prime Accounting Solutions
Culver City, CA

“My office admin agent ‘Clawdius’ (yes that’s his real name) initiates outbound compliance mail, permit filings, and follow up which saves us hours every month as a contractor.”

Roi Y🤖🦞Clawdius

Founder & Installer
Los Angeles, CA

[Human-grade logistics]

You submit documents & letters
We print & handle the post office

Every outbound letter is printed, stuffed, stamped, and mailed by trained facility staff. Fulfillment photos verify every piece. You get structured webhooks at every stage — no post office visits, ever.

PDFs printed and stuffed with your return address

Postage applied — USPS or FedEx

Fulfillment photos verify every mailed piece

Webhooks fire: submitted → ready → mailed → delivered

[Inbound & outbound mail]

Every piece of mail,
structured instantly

Your webhook receives a small, signed JSON event for every item: the sender line read from the envelope, letter or package, page counts, and two URLs. Page text and images never travel in the payload; your agent fetches them with its API key.

To send, call send_outbound_mail over MCP, or POST /v1/mail, with a document, a recipient and a mail class.

Inbound

  • inbound.received
  • inbound.action.requested
  • inbound.action.completed
  • inbound.pages_ready
  • inbound.keywords_matched

Outbound

  • mail.pending_approval
  • mail.submitted
  • mail.ready
  • mail.mailed
  • mail.delivered

POSTyour-agent.example.com/mail-webhook200 OK

{"event_type": "inbound.received","item": {"reference": "SAMPLE-09941F955E23","kind": "letter","sender": "Mojave Land Partners","status": "received","pages": { "envelope": 1, "contents": 0 }},"api_url": "https://mailbox.bot/api/v1/inbound-items/b434⁠…⁠f6a6","pages_url": "https://mailbox.bot/api/v1/inbound-items/b434⁠…⁠f6a6/pages"// 9 more fields in the full payload}

Signed · Standard Webhooks v1 · HMAC-SHA256

MCPsend_outbound_mailor POST /v1/mail

{"document_filename": "notice.pdf","document_base64": "JVBERi0xLjcK…","mailbox_md_version": 3,"recipient_name": "State of Delaware","recipient_line1": "401 Federal Street","recipient_city": "Dover","recipient_state": "DE","recipient_zip": "19901","mail_class": "certified_return_receipt","requires_approval": true// also: dry_run, max_cost_cents, metadata}

Plays nice with MCP · REST API · Hermes · OpenClaw · A2A

[Security]

Business mail documents are encrypted at rest and regularly purged

[All major carriers supported]

USPSFedExUPSDHLAmazonOnTracLaserShipGSO

[Works with your agent or framework]

[FAQ]

Frequently
asked
questions

[Get started]

Get your limited spot for a physical mailing address at location #1.Location #2 and #3 will be in Nevada and Utah.

Location #1 is our staffed Manhattan Beach, California facility. Each mailbox is a virtual mailbox at a real street address, not a PO Box. Create your account, verify your phone number and choose the mailbox option; your mailbox number is assigned after USPS Form 1583 verification.

POST/api/v1/signupCURL

curl -X POST https://mailbox.bot/api/v1/signup \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"full_name":"Jane Smith","email":"you@co.com","password":"s3cure-pass","needs":"a mailing address for my agent, plus outbound mail"}'

Agent-callable account signup: no CAPTCHA and no bearer token on this endpoint. It creates a human-owned account, sends the verification email, and returns the checklist your agent should relay before live credentials or mail sending are possible.

mailbox.bot issues receiving addresses and handles packages at the staffed Manhattan Beach, CA facility (2100 N Sepulveda Blvd STE 28, Manhattan Beach, CA 90266). To get a mailing address #, call /api/v1/mailing-address-requests first and pass the returned lead_id into signup. Then connect through LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, MCP, A2A, or the REST API.
